2011.question: Read carefully the given stanza and answer the following questions:
2011.prashna: दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2011.context:
A twenty five kilo load on his back
spine double bent
a six-mile climb up in the snows of winter
naked bones, skeleton-like frail frame
yet facing an uphill task
he is challenging the mountain.

sub_questions.1: (i) How much load does the porter have on his back?
sub_questions.2: (ii) Write down the name of the poem concerned.
sub_questions.3: (iii) What distance does the porter cover in the snows of winter?

anuprashna.1: (i) कुली की पीठ पर कितना भार है?
anuprashna.3: (iii) कुली सर्दियों की बर्फ में कितनी दूरी तय करता है?
anuprashna.4: (iv) पर्वत को कौन चुनौती दे रहा है?

2013.question: Read carefully the given stanza and answer the following questions:
2013.prashna: दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2013.context:
Like a bird
his heart is twittering panting
he is sweating and out of breath
A hut on the cliff.
his son, shivering with cold
woes of hunger
the mother searching for nettles and vines.

sub_questions.1: How does the poet give an idea of time?
sub_questions.2: What made the poet in brief??
sub_questions.3: Why is the porter's son shivering?

anuprashna.1: कवि समय का विचार कैसे देता है?
anuprashna.2: संक्षेप में कवि को किसने बनाया??
anuprashna.3: कुली का बेटा क्यों काँप रहा है?
anuprashna.4: बिछुआ (nettles) और बेलों (vines) की व्याख्या करें।
